scope: Post-hoc descriptive reanalysis of existing synthetic development predictions. No training or inference. No claim of independent generalization or causal attribution.

definitions.exact_same_output: Two inverse queries have identical serialized interval lists; both-empty is also counted and separately reported.
definitions.nonempty_equivalent: Both nonempty and set-IoU between the two predictions >= 0.995.
definitions.recovery: JointPairAcc@0.5 success on the subset selected by SFT seed 0 exact_same_output. Output change alone does not count as recovery.
definitions.comparison_scope: Only SFT seed 0 exists; other seeds use that same descriptive reference, not matched-SFT causal effects.
